content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Sioux Falls

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates hold a bachelor's degree plus requisite years of direct project-leadership experience, or an associate degree with additional experience. Review PMI's formal eligibility criteria before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Hours of Formal Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, learn from active certified practitioners, and master the PMBOK® Guide framework and exam domains. This formal coursework satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement for credential eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute and submit your PMP application, documenting your project-management experience and educational background. Pay the associated PMI exam fee. PMI will review and approve your application before you can schedule your examination.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—including practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts and reinforce critical topics as you finalize your readiness.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle by attending training, leading projects, and engaging in professional activities. Submit your PDU documentation to PMI before your credential expires to maintain active PMP status and career advancement.
